items.markdown:
`There is no fixed total number of individual development loans active in the UK at any given time` , as the market is made up of thousands of private, rolling short-term contracts handled by **well over 100 specialist lenders** , mainstream high-street banks, and challenger institutions.[](https://brickflow.com/development-finance-lenders) [[1]](https://brickflow.com/development-finance-lenders)[[2]](https://nmfinance.co.uk/your-complete-property-development-finance-guide-in-the-uk/)[[3]](https://ukandeu.ac.uk/explainers/development-banks/)[[4]](https://brickflow.com/brickflow-thinks/how-does-property-development-finance-work)UK Development Finance Market Overview

- **Active Lenders** : More than 100 active providers offer property and project development funding across the UK, including names like [Shawbrook Bank](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/property-finance/development-finance/) and [United Trust Bank](https://www.utbank.co.uk/lending/development-finance/).[[1]](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/property-finance/development-finance/)[[2]](https://propp.io/development-finance)
- **Loan Sizes** : Typically range from £150,000 or £200,000 at the lower end up to £35 million–£50+ million for large residential or commercial schemes.[](https://www.utbank.co.uk/lending/development-finance/) [[1]](https://www.utbank.co.uk/lending/development-finance/)[[2]](https://swoopfunding.com/uk/commercial-mortgages/development-finance/)
- **Typical Terms** : Short-term facilities generally last between **12 to 36 months** , with funds released in staged drawdowns tied to construction milestones rather than a single lump sum.[](https://www.iwoca.co.uk/finance-explained/property-development-loans) [[1]](https://www.iwoca.co.uk/finance-explained/property-development-loans)
- **Public Schemes** : Government-backed initiatives like the [Home Building Fund](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/levelling-up-home-building-fund-development-finance) also supply continuous pipelines of development finance for residential builders.[](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/levelling-up-home-building-fund-development-finance) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/levelling-up-home-building-fund-development-finance)[[2]](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/housing-statistics-1-april-2019-to-30-september-2019/housing-statistics-december-2019-accessible-version)[[3]](https://www.introducertoday.co.uk/breaking-news/2026/01/government-massive-retrofit-programme-backed-by-lenders-and-institutions/)

If you are looking for specific figures, let me know:

- Are you looking for the **total monetary value** lent in a specific year?
- Do you need information on a **particular region** (like Scotland or Wales)?
- Are you trying to **find a lender** for a specific project size?
